title: Implementation is getting cheap. Is taste the new bottleneck?
author: Fr3yz
selftext:
Now that "implementation" is accelerated with AI, will the current bottleneck of great creation is "taste"? We can create assets must faster, decent music easier/cheaper, and make a working prototype within hours. 

There'll be thousands of competitors and games with beautiful arts, assets and mechanics that it'll flood the market.

History has run this experiment a few times too. Photography made realistic images cheap. Then DAWs and sample packs did the same for clean-sounding music, and Unity plus asset stores did it for playable games.

What'll be the differentiator? Is it taste, polish and patience? Is it human touch and vision? Or something else? What do you think?
